# The Lily Studio

> The Lily Studio is an independent product studio founded in 2026 by Jessica Levine. It makes Claude AI skills (ready-to-install skill files that make Claude better at specific jobs), iOS apps, and Lily's Playhouse, a little living world of free, cozy browser games.

## Claude AI skills

184 tools for work, study and life: 89 Pro Skills, 47 Literary Companions, 28 Wisdom Companions and 20 Bundles. Sold on Etsy and Gumroad.

- [All Claude AI skills](https://thelilystudio.com/skills.html): the full catalog, with descriptions, prices and links to buy
- [Etsy shop](https://thelilystudioshop.etsy.com)
- [Gumroad shop](https://thelilystudio.gumroad.com)

## iOS apps

- [Apps](https://thelilystudio.com/apps.html): Blocks and Breath, Calming Water: Baby & Toddler, and Fidge

## Lily's Playhouse (free games, nothing to download)

- [Lily's Playhouse](https://thelilystudio.com/playhouse/): a little world where frogs, bunnies and bees live together
- [Free games](https://thelilystudio.com/playhouse/games/): all of Lily's games in one place
- [Lily's Hop Hop](https://thelilystudio.com/hophop/): help Hop Hop, a very round frog, make the pond bloom
- [Lily's Hop Hop · Live](https://thelilystudio.com/hophop/watch/): watch Hop Hop's cozy day live, in real time, with the real sun and moon
- [Lily's Buzz Buzz](https://thelilystudio.com/buzzbuzz/): hop Buzz Buzz the bee across giant flowers, make the buds bloom, and fly the pollen home to her hive
- [Lily's Bun Nee Nee](https://thelilystudio.com/neenee/): hop around the garden with Nee Nee the bunny, keep her tummy full of carrots, and meet her bunny friends
